messages.context: Coach Jackrabbit 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fDaddy's the kind of steady you need in a storm. If he was any more laid back, he'd be horizontal. But that's why we never tilt!
messages.text: Daddy's the kind of steady you need in a storm. If he was any more laid back, he'd be horizontal. But that's why we never tilt!
messages.zh: Daddy 就是那种能让大家在风暴中稳住阵脚的人。他要是再悠闲一点,恐怕就直接躺平了。不过也正因如此,我们从不慌乱!

messages.context: Coach Jackrabbit 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fSis' spirit is so fiery, I keep a bucket of water handy. Just in case her passion for change sets the place ablaze!
messages.text: Sis' spirit is so fiery, I keep a bucket of water handy. Just in case her passion for change sets the place ablaze!
messages.zh: Sis 的脾气火爆得很,我总在手边备一桶水,免得她改革的热情真把这里点着了!
